<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Arrived" name="Car arrived at service facility" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Car Service" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Event</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Timer_30</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Fine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Status</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotReg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Owner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Arrived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Problems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Next</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Service successful" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check" name="Check if car is still registered" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Reg" name="Car still registered?" default="F_No" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Notify" name="Notify car owner" />
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gw_Event" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30" name="30 days">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Fine" name="Fine car owner" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Arrived" name="Car arrives at service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Msg_Arrived" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Problems" name="Enter problems of the car" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_Split" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Status" name="Send status updates via email" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay through the app" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Success" name="Enter that repair was successful and Pickerl was given" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_Join" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Next" name="Enter time for next service" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotReg" name="Car not registered" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Done" name="Service completed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Gw_Reg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Reg" targetRef="Task_Notify">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">registered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_No" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Reg" targetRef="End_NotReg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Gw_Event" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Gw_Event" targetRef="Catch_Arrived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Gw_Event" targetRef="Timer_30" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Timer_30" targetRef="Task_Fine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_Fine" targetRef="End_Fined" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Catch_Arrived" targetRef="Task_Problems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Task_Problems" targetRef="Gw_Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Gw_Split" targetRef="Task_Status" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Gw_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Task_Success" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Task_Status" targetRef="Gw_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="Task_Success" targetRef="Gw_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" sourceRef="Gw_Join" targetRef="Task_Next" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="Task_Next" targetRef="End_Done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
